description: Conducted Investigations and resolutions of workplace issues/inquiries from field employees and management. Served as a partner for managers and employees by ensuring application of company policies and procedures.
Created and conducted training for hourly and salaried employees. Support performance management process for all employees.

Monitored inventory control, processed physical counts of all merchandise, organized and secured all inventory (including cellular devices and accessories), and responsible for shipping and receiving of inventory. Investigated and resolved any inventory discrepancies.
Merchandising, assist with floor sets, create service desk tickets for defective equipment.

Verified and updated business caption listings in (database) Common Suite System using setup forms received from the Directory Marketing Unit group. Review each Directory Listing Report in detail to confirm the accuracy of the data.
Interpret, verify, analyze and input listings from advertising orders. Input payroll, provided payroll administrative support for employees.

certifications.name: Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, Publisher and PowerPoint)

matchmaking_summary: The candidate is a highly skilled HR professional with extensive experience in employee relations and training. Their background includes roles in store operations and payroll administration, demonstrating strong attention to detail and organizational skills. Additionally, the candidate has demonstrated leadership through their involvement in community organizations such as the Order of the Eastern Star and the AT&T Community Network - Michigan Chapter.
